sections.section: RULES - Assistant Sub-Inspector (Appointment Promotion and Conditions Of Service) Rules 2011
sections.description:
ASSISTANT SUB-INSPECTOR (APPOINTMENT,
ASSISTANT SUB-INSPECTOR (APPOINTMENT,
PROMOTION AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE)
RULES, 2011
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
12th December, 2012]
No.8984/SE-II/VI,
dated 12-8-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred under Article 112 of the
Police Order, 2002 (22 of 2002), the Provincial Police Officer of the Punjab,
with the approval of the Government is pleased to make the following rules:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) These rules may be cited as the Assistant
Sub-Inspector (Appointment, Promotion and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2011.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---In
these rules: --
(a) "appointing
authority" means the Head of the District Police as mentioned in Article
23 of the Police Order;
(b) "Commission"
means the Punjab Public Service Commission;
(c) "Initial
recruitment" means recruitment as Assistant Sub-Inspector on the
recommendation of the Commission;
(d) 'Police
Order" means the Police Order, 2002 (22 of 2002)
(e) "Provincial
Police Officer" means the Police Officer posted as Provincial Police
Officer of the Punjab under Article 11 of the Police Order;
(f) "recruitment
through selection" means selection of a graduate Constable or a Head
Constable to the rank of Assistant Sub-Inspector on the recommendation of the
Commission; and
(g) "Schedule"
means the Schedule appended with the rules.
3. Appointment.---The
appointing authority shall, on the recommendations of the Commission and with
the prior approval of the Provincial Police Officer, appoint a person as
Assistant Sub-Inspector.
4 Procedure
for appointment.---(1) The Provincial Police Officer shall separately make
a reference to the Commission to fill up the posts of Assistant Sub-Inspector
available for initial recruitment or, as the case may be, by recruitment
through selection from amongst eligible graduate Constable and Head Constables.
(2) The
Commission shall, conduct an examination and make recommendations to the
Provincial Police Officer for appointment to the posts of the Assistant
Sub-Inspectors in terms of the reference.
5. Probation.---(1)
An Assistant Sub-Inspector appointed under these rules shall remain on
probation for a maximum period of three years.
(2) An
Assistant Sub-Inspector shall not be confirmed in the post unless he has
successfully completed the training and passed such departmental examination(s)
as may be prescribed by the Provincial Police Officer.
(3) The
appointing authority shall terminate the service of an Assistant Sub-Inspector
who fails to complete the training successfully and pass the said departmental
examination(s) during the period of probation.
6. Seniority.---(1)
The Regional Police Officer concerned shall maintain a seniority list of
Assistant Sub-Inspectors on the basis of their respective dates of appointment.
(2) The
inter se seniority of Assistant Sub-Inspectors appointed on the recommendation
of the Commission shall be determined in accordance with the respective merit
assigned to them by the Commission and they would be placed at the bottom of
the existing seniority list of Assistant Sub-Inspectors.
(3) The
seniority of the in-service graduate Constable and Head Constables, on
appointment as Assistant Sub-Inspectors, shall be determined from the date of
appointment as Assistant Sub-Inspector and shall be placed at the bottom of the
seniority list, and their previous service shall be counted for purposes of
pensionary benefits and not for determination of seniority as Assistant
Sub-Inspectors.
(4) If
Assistant Sub-Inspectors are appointed on the same date through any of the
modes of appointment, the Assistant Sub-Inspectors promoted on the basis of the
seniority-cum-fitness shall rank senior to the other Assistant Sub-Inspectors
and the Assistant Sub-Inspectors appointed through selection by the Commission
from the graduate Constables or Head Constables shall rank senior to the
